args.sql: SELECT min(day) as min_day, max(day) as max_day, count(*) as cnt, count(distinct region) as regions FROM memory.bench.daily_region_revenue
SELECT min(order_ts) as min_ts, max(order_ts) as max_ts, count(*) as cnt, count(distinct status) as statuses FROM memory.bench.orders
SELECT status, count(*) FROM memory.bench.orders GROUP BY status
SELECT count(*) as cnt, count(distinct region) as regions FROM memory.bench.customers
SELECT min(order_date), max(order_date), count(*) FROM memory.bench.legacy_orders
SELECT region, round(sum(gross_revenue_usd),2) as total FROM memory.bench.daily_region_revenue WHERE year(day)=2025 GROUP BY region ORDER BY region

SELECT c.region, o.status, count(*) as cnt, round(sum((o.amount - o.discount)/100.0),2) as net_total, round(sum(o.amount/100.0),2) as gross_total
FROM memory.bench.orders o JOIN memory.bench.customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE year(o.order_ts)=2025
GROUP BY c.region, o.status ORDER BY c.region, o.status

SELECT c.region, count(*) as cnt, round(sum(l.total),2) as total
FROM memory.bench.legacy_orders l JOIN memory.bench.customers c ON l.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE year(l.order_date)=2025
GROUP BY c.region ORDER BY c.region
